man-runner-2048.title: Man Runner 2048: Run, Merge, and Conquer!
man-runner-2048.slogan: Run, Merge, and Conquer in Man Runner 2048!
man-runner-2048.description: Man Runner 2048 is a fun casual game where you run and merge men to reach 2048. Your goal is to get the highest score on each level so you can shoot the giant monsters with the most power. Experience the thrill of merging and running in this exciting game. Play Man Runner 2048 now and see how far you can go!
